border-active.$description: Selected indicators: active tab underline, selected card outline, sidebar marker.

border-hairline.$description: Every divider and control border. Fjord separates with hairlines and fills, never heavy frames.

accent.$description: THE interactive colour: primary buttons, links, focus ring, active tab/selection markers, checked controls. Frost blue in Night/Day, aurora teal in Aurora. Readable as text on every surface.

accent-hover.$description: Hover state of an `accent` fill or link.

accent-soft.$description: Tinted fill behind a selected item, a soft badge or the current day in a calendar. Text on it is `accent-ink`.

ansi-black.$description: ANSI 0. Matches `bg-raised` in dark themes so 'black' backgrounds stay visible on `bg-base`.

ansi-bright-black.$description: ANSI 8. Dim or hint text and autosuggestions: at least 4.5:1 on bg-base in every theme at full opacity. Do not apply extra dimming.

aurora.$description: Aurora teal. Functions/methods in code, the Aurora theme's accent, chart series 2.

bg-active.$description: Pressed fill and the neutral selected row. Seed: oklch(35.00% 0.034 250) in Night.

bg-base.$description: Default page, window and editor background. Seed: oklch(20.88% 0.018 245) in Night. Body text `ink` sits here.

bg-hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons. Seed: oklch(32.95% 0.034 247) in Night.

bg-inverse.$description: Inverted chips such as tooltips and the Kbd key cap shadow side. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

bg-raised.$description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, hover cards. Always paired with `shadow-overlay`.

bg-sunken.$description: Deepest ground: terminal and editor gutter wells, inset code blocks, the track behind sliders and progress bars, the page behind a desktop of windows.

bg-surface.$description: Panels, cards, sidebars, table bodies and inputs: one step up from `bg-base`.

danger.$description: Errors and destructive actions: a stronger, redder sibling of `rose` so it stays apart from `warning`. Always with the octagon icon or a word.

danger-soft.$description: Background of a danger alert/badge; text `danger` or `ink`.

diff-add-bg.$description: Background of an added line in a diff; `ink` on it.

diff-del-bg.$description: Background of a removed line in a diff; `ink` on it.

fern.$description: Fern green, a stronger sibling of sage. Success, git additions, the ANSI green slot, regex in code. Text-safe on every surface.

foam.$description: Cappuccino foam. Seed: oklch(86.99% 0.028 46). Strings in code, warm highlights, avatar fallbacks.

frost.$description: Cool frost blue. Types/classes in code, info, links when `accent` is aurora. Text-safe on every surface.

info-soft.$description: Background of an info alert/badge; its text is `info` or `ink`.

ink.$description: Primary text and solid icons on `bg-base`, `bg-surface`, `bg-raised`, `bg-hover`, `bg-active`.

ink-disabled.$description: Disabled labels and icons only (WCAG-exempt). Never for content.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, placeholder-free helper text. 4.5:1+ on every surface including `bg-active`.

ink-subtle.$description: Tertiary text: timestamps, line numbers, input placeholders. 4.5:1+ on `bg-base`, `bg-surface` and `bg-raised`; not for long copy.

latte.$description: Café latte. Seed: oklch(76.09% 0.065 71). Warnings, numbers/constants in code, the ANSI yellow slot - the only place a yellow-ish hue appears.

lilac.$description: Muted lilac. Keywords and storage in code, chart series 4. Cool counterweight to the café tones.

line.$description: Hairline dividers between regions (1px). Separates panels without adding a frame; never on control outlines.

line-strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons) and the scroll thumb. Holds 3:1 on `bg-base` and `bg-surface` in every theme.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (primary button label, checked checkbox tick). Dark in Night/Aurora, white in Day.

on-danger.$description: Label on a solid `danger` fill (destructive button).

rose.$description: Dusty rose. Seed: oklch(75.93% 0.066 10). Danger/errors, variables and tags in code, git deletions.

sage.$description: Pale sage. Seed: oklch(86.93% 0.028 130). Quiet decorative accent: avatar fallbacks, tags, the bright end of green ramps. For success use `fern`.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind dialogs, sheets and drawers. No blur - Fjord never uses backdrop blur.

search-match.$description: Search/find match background and the Marker highlight; `ink` on it. Latte-tinted so it is findable without breaking the palette.

selection.$description: Text selection and editor selection background. `ink` stays readable on it.

success-soft.$description: Background of a success alert/badge; text `success` or `ink`.

caption.$description: Timestamps and captions, in `ink-subtle`. Never smaller.

code.$description: Editors, terminals and code blocks. Ligatures on (`calt`).

code-italic.$description: Comments and keywords in code (Cascadia Code has a cursive italic).

code-small.$description: Inline metadata: shortcuts, file sizes, durations, git refs.

display.$description: One per screen at most: hero titles, empty dashboards, splash.

label.$description: Form labels, button text at sm size.

lead.$description: Intro paragraph under a page title, in `ink-muted`.

org.xerrion.fjord.sample: A calm, cool theme for work and play.

overline.$description: Uppercase group labels in menus, sidebars and table headers.

z-modal.$description: Dialogs, sheets, drawers and their scrim.

z-popover.$description: Menus, popovers, hover cards, select lists.

z-base.$description: Base document content within a stacking context.

z-sticky.$description: Sticky navigation within its document stacking context.

control-compact.$description: Minimum compact control height; allow text to increase the height.

control-comfortable.$description: Minimum comfortable control height; typography remains unchanged.

target-minimum.$description: Minimum interactive target extent; visible icon size is independent.

target-touch.$description: Minimum coarse-pointer hit area in both dimensions.

icon-control.$description: Filled icon beside a control label.

icon-status.$description: Filled icon beside status text or navigation.

breakpoint-sm.$description: Small content threshold for responsive composition.

breakpoint-md.$description: Medium content threshold for responsive composition.

breakpoint-lg.$description: Wide application threshold; retain the content width limit.

content-max.$description: Maximum outer page width including gutters.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between a control edge and its keyboard focus outline.

page-gutter.$description: Page padding below the small breakpoint.

page-gutter-wide.$description: Page padding from the small breakpoint.

gap-comfortable.$description: Density changes spacing while retaining text size and line height.

padding-comfortable.$description: Density changes spacing while retaining text size and line height.

gap-compact.$description: Density changes spacing while retaining text size and line height.

padding-compact.$description: Density changes spacing while retaining text size and line height.
